AKMAL YEZDANI

📞 +91 9123250950 | ✉ akmal_yezdani@yahoo.com | 🌐 https://www.linkedin.com/in/akmalyezdani Technical Project Manager | Delivery Manager | Program Manager | PMP®, PSPO® | Agile Delivery | Cloud & Digital Transformation | BFSI, Insurance, Logistics & Retail PROFILE SUMMARY Accomplished Technical Project Manager / Delivery Manager with 17+ years of progressive experience spanning software development, technical leadership, project management, and enterprise software delivery across BFSI, Insurance, Retail, and Logistics domains. PMP® and PSPO® certified with expertise in Agile delivery, PMO governance, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and global program execution across USA, UK, India, and GCC regions.

Proven track record of delivering enterprise software programs on time and within budget while improving delivery predictability through KPI-driven governance, RAID management, and Agile best practices.

Strong technical understanding of Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, AWS, Kafka, CI/CD, Terraform, and .NET, enabling effective collaboration with architects, engineering teams, and DevOps teams throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

Leveraging AI-powered productivity tools including GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, and Claude to accelerate requirements analysis, user story creation, documentation, solution design discussions, code reviews, and overall delivery efficiency across Agile software programs. CAREER SNAPSHOT

Career progression from Software Developer / Software Engineer → Project Lead → Technical Project Manager →

Delivery Manager

Delivered enterprise software programs across Insurance, BFSI, Retail and Logistics with consistent focus on on-time

delivery, quality and governance

Managed cross-functional teams of 30+ members across Software Development, QA and DevOps, while collaborating

closely with Product Owners and Business stakeholders.

Led Agile, Scrum and Hybrid delivery programs with global stakeholders across USA, UK, India and GCC • Strong technical background in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, AWS, Kafka, CI/CD, Terraform, and .NET, enabling effective collaboration with architects, engineering teams, and DevOps teams throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

Extensive experience in Project Governance, PMO, Risk & Issue Management, Budget Tracking, Release Management

and Stakeholder Management

CORE COMPETENCIES Technical Project Management | Program & Delivery Management | Agile & Scrum | PMO & Governance | Stakeholder Management | Vendor Management (RFP/SOW) | Risk, Issue & Change Management | Budget & Financial Management | Resource Planning | Release Management | Cloud Migration & Modernization | Cross-Functional Team Leadership TECHNICAL STACK Languages & Frameworks: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC, Web API Architecture & Integration: Microservices, REST APIs, Apache Kafka Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD (Jenkins) Tools: Jira, Confluence, MS Project, ServiceNow Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server Delivery Frameworks / Methodologies: Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall Additional Exposure: Static code analysis (SonarQube) AI & Productivity Tools: GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude (requirements analysis, documentation generation, user story creation, solution exploration, code assistance, and productivity acceleration) PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE Project Manager – Delivery | Cambridge Technology Enterprise Ltd (CTE WebApps) Jul 2022 – Dec 2024

Led multi-project Agile delivery across insurance and logistics portfolios, ensuring on-time and within-budget

execution

Owned end-to-end project delivery including scope, estimation, planning, execution, and release management across

global programs

• Managed cross-functional teams of 30+ members across Software Development, QA and DevOps, driving effective

team coordination and predictable sprint delivery

• Managed vendor relations by contributing to RFP evaluations and SOW definitions to ensure accurate project scope

alignment

Defined and implemented KPI dashboards (velocity, defects, burndown), enhancing delivery visibility and leadership

decision-making Strengthened RAID and change management practices, reducing delivery risks and unplanned escalations

• Collaborated with stakeholders across USA, UK, India, and GCC, ensuring alignment on release goals, compliance, and priorities

Chaired governance and steering meetings, ensuring transparent reporting, risk tracking, and stakeholder alignment • Mentored project leads and Scrum Masters, driving Agile adoption and high-performance team culture • Coordinated releases across multiple applications and environments, ensuring alignment between business,

development, QA, and DevOps teams Technical Project Manager | Tresbu Digital Sep 2021 – Jul 2022

Delivered Agile projects using Scrum, improving team velocity and sprint outcomes. • Collaborated with product owners to refine backlog and reduce scope ambiguity • Supported CI/CD improvements, reducing deployment issues and delays

Deputy Manager – Project Management | HCL Technologies Dec 2019 – Aug 2021

Managed end-to-end delivery of enterprise IT solutions for BFSI clients, overseeing planning, execution, governance,

risk management, and stakeholder communication across multiple workstreams

Led UAT governance and compliance readiness, ensuring full audit traceability and stakeholder alignment • Developed governance templates for risk management, reporting, and KPI tracking across multiple client engagements

Drove continuous improvement initiatives, reducing defect leakage and improving delivery quality

SELECTED PRIOR EXPERIENCE

Associate Technical Lead | Softvision (Nov 2018 – May 2019) – Led delivery teams and developed backend services;

contributed to architecture design and code reviews

Technical Project Manager | ABCO InfoTech (May 2016 – May 2018) – Managed Agile delivery of web applications and

supported architecture decisions

Team Lead | TeamLease (Jul 2015 – Apr 2016) – Led delivery teams and built backend services • Project Lead | HCL Technologies (Sep 2010 – Jun 2015) – Managed teams and developed enterprise backend systems • Software Engineer | TASMEA IT Solutions (Jul 2006 – Sep 2008) – Developed backend and database-driven applications as a Software Developer Software Engineer | Cal-INFO (Aug 2005 – Jul 2006) – Built backend services and SQL-based applications as a Software Developer



Representative Project – Insurance Platform Overview: Led the delivery of a microservices-based Insurance Platform integrating multiple business domains — Auth, Customer, Policy, Quote, and Document. Tech Stack: Spring Boot, Kafka, PostgreSQL, AWS, Angular, Docker, Jenkins Highlights:

Led delivery of modular microservices with centralized authentication and API Gateway (Spring Cloud Gateway +

Eureka) • Integrated Kafka for event-driven communication, enabling real-time data synchronization across services • Implemented audit logging, RBAC, and AWS S3 document storage for secure and scalable delivery • Established structured sprint execution, governance reporting and release management practices • • Coordinated end-to-end delivery across Authentication, Customer, Policy, Quote, Document, and Notification services

Improved deployment efficiency through CI/CD-driven release processes

following Agile delivery practices

CERTIFICATIONS

PMP® – Project Management Institute (PMI) • PSPO™ – Scrum.org

EDUCATION Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) – 2005
